name: Ory Enterprise SaaS Starter Kit
description: An open-source Next.js Enterprise SaaS Starter Kit powered by Ory identity infrastructure. Start with authentication, enterprise access, and the features every SaaS product needs so you can focus on what makes your app unique.

ORY_SDK_URL.description: Ory Kratos public API URL (Ory Network or a self-hosted Kratos).

NEXT_PUBLIC_ORY_SDK_URL.description: Browser-facing Ory Kratos public API URL.

POLIS_OPENID_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Base64-encoded PEM (PKCS#8) RS256 private key for Ory Polis id_token signing.

POLIS_OPENID_PUBLIC_KEY.description: Base64-encoded PEM (SPKI) RS256 public key for Ory Polis id_token signing.

APP_URL.description: Public root URL of the Enterprise SaaS installation, replace <HEROKU_APP_NAME> with the app name.
